result.topic_en: A note stating that the proof of a final formula would be complete if a certain identity among products $\Pi(\cdot,x)$ holds.
result.transcription:
Proof of final formula completed if it is true that
$\frac{\Pi(-b,x)}{\Pi(a,x)} \Big/ \frac{\Pi(-c,x)}{\Pi(-a,x)} = \frac{\Pi(-b,x)}{\Pi(-c,x)}$.

methods.what: Proposed identity of ratios of products $\Pi$ needed to complete a proof (it would require $\Pi(-a,x)=\Pi(a,x)$)
